title: 熱移動工学
subtitle: Heat Transfer
teachers:
FUJIMOTO Masanori
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn the concept of heat transfer.
(2) Learn basic conductive heat transfer.
(3) Learn basic convective heat transfer.
(4) Learn the basis of heat transfer with phase change.
(5) Learn the basis of radiative heat transfer.
advice:
This is a basic course in heat transfer. We will cover the following topics:

1. Heat transfer
2. Conductive heat transfer
3. Convective heat transfer
4. Heat transfer with phase change
5. Radiative heat transfer

Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas.
Students are expected to solve the exercises independently.
Students should be aware of the teacher’s instructions in the class, because the schedules of quizzes, tests, and reports may change as the class progresses.
Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts.
books: How to Study Heat Transfer Engineering
requiredKnowledge:
Thermodynamics I and II, Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics I and II.
Have sufficient skill in mathematics (especially differential/integral and vector inner/outcome calculations).
Have basic knowledge of mechanics (the zeroth, first, and second laws of thermodynamics and boundary layers).
Know how to use a calculator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain heat transfer.
Be able to explain conductive heat transfer.
Be able to explain convective heat transfer.
Be able to explain heat transfer with phase change.
Be able to explain radiative heat transfer.
Be able to design heat transfer equipment (such as a heat exchanger).

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Explain the concepts of terms such as heat transfer and correctly use SI units related to mechanics.
(2) Express conductive heat transfer by equations and explain its behavior.
(3) Express forced convection and free convection by equations and explain its behavior.
(4) Express heat transfer with phase change by equations and explain its behavior.
(5) Express radiative heat transfer by equations and explain its behavior.
(6) Design heat transfer equipment (such as a heat exchanger) and solve equations for it.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Explain the concepts of terms such as heat transfer and correctly use SI units related to elementary mechanics.
(2) Express conductive heat transfer by equations.
(3) Express forced convection and free convection by equations.
(4) Express heat transfer with phase change by equations.
(5) Express radiative heat transfer by equations.
(6) Design heat transfer equipment (such as a heat exchanger) and solve elementary equations for it.
